description: TLS 1.3 and QUIC-TLS for the IronSecurity stack, in Rust over IronCrypto, with certificate validation by IronPKI and machine-readable reports of what each connection established. A library; it is not an information system.

controls.title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
controls.bearing: IronSocketLayer protects the data an application sends over a connection it makes or accepts with TLS 1.3 or QUIC-TLS.

compliance.gap: Only data the caller sends through IronSocketLayer is protected; whether every transmission does is the system's. The cryptography is IronCrypto's, which is not CMVP validated (see SC-13).

controls.title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity | Cryptographic Protection
controls.bearing: Every record is protected with an AEAD cipher under keys from an authenticated TLS 1.3 handshake, so disclosure is prevented and changes are detected.

compliance.gap: The cryptographic mechanisms are IronCrypto's, which is not CMVP validated (see SC-13).

controls.title: Cryptographic Protection
controls.bearing: IronSocketLayer uses cryptography to protect data in transit and to authenticate peers.

compliance.reason: All of IronSocketLayer's cryptography comes from IronCrypto, which is not CMVP validated. Its FIPS profile restricts a connection to FIPS-approved algorithms and enforces IronCrypto's approved-mode gate; that is not validation.

controls.title: Session Authenticity
controls.bearing: IronSocketLayer authenticates the peer of each connection by certificate path validation or a pinned key, and binds the session's keys to that authentication through the TLS 1.3 handshake transcript.

controls.title: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to prevent unauthorized disclosure of CUI during transmission unless otherwise protected by alternative physical safeguards
controls.bearing: IronSocketLayer protects data a caller sends through it with TLS 1.3 or QUIC-TLS.

compliance.gap: Whether CUI is sent only through IronSocketLayer is the system's, and the cryptography is not FIPS validated (see SC.L2-3.13.11).

controls.title: Employ FIPS-validated cryptography when used to protect the confidentiality of CUI
controls.bearing: IronSocketLayer's cryptography protects the confidentiality of data in transit.

compliance.reason: IronCrypto, which provides all of IronSocketLayer's cryptography, is not CMVP validated.

controls.title: Protect the authenticity of communications sessions
controls.bearing: IronSocketLayer authenticates each connection's peer and binds the session's keys to that authentication.
